wish: someone should make a running app that plays your playlist only when you move above a set speed
spec:
Plays your music (or a built-in beat) only while your GPS speed is above a limit you set.
Tap start, pick your music files, set the km/h limit, then run; it pauses after about a second below the limit and resumes when you speed up.
It does not stream playlists from music apps, and the test speed field replaces GPS for trying it indoors.
notes: Offline: music comes from files you pick on the device, not from streaming apps. Built-in beat plays until files are added. Speed uses GPS; browsers may stop GPS when the screen locks.
